nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$ and let $a_1, \dots, a_m$ be positive integers. Then the polynomial $\varphi(x) = x^m - a_1 x^{m-1} - \cdots - a_m$ has exactly one positive real root $\lambda$, this root satisfies $\lambda > 1$, and the complex roots of $\varphi$, counted with multiplicity, are $\lambda$ (a simple root) together with $m - 1$ roots of modulus less than $\lambda$.
nodes.title: Dominant root of $x^m - a_1 x^{m-1} - \cdots - a_m$ with positive coefficients

nodes.summary: Let $a_0 + a_1 x + \cdots + a_n x^n$ be a nonzero real polynomial of degree $n$ with $0 \le a_0 \le a_1 \le \cdots \le a_n$. Then every complex root $z$ of this polynomial satisfies $|z| \le 1$.
nodes.title: Eneström–Kakeya theorem

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ and $\lambda$ be real numbers with $1 < \mu < \lambda$, let $c \ne 0$ be a real number, and let $(e_k)_{k \ge 0}$ be a real sequence with $e_k = O\bigl((\mu/\lambda^3)^{k/2}\bigr)$ as $k \to \infty$. Then, as $n \to \infty$, $\prod_{k \ge n} \bigl(1 - 1/(c\lambda^k) + e_k\bigr) = 1 - \sum_{k \ge n} 1/(c\lambda^k) + O\bigl((\mu/\lambda^3)^{n/2}\bigr)$.
nodes.title: Asymptotic expansion of a perturbed tail product
